description: This file defines a PHP interface `ValueXModifiable` within the namespace `OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField`. The interface specifies a single method `xValueModifier` meant for modifying or preparing a value `x` for persistence, which implies it is part of a report filtering system in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: ValueXModifiable
classes.description: An interface that requires implementing classes to define a method `xValueModifier` for processing a string or null value before persisting.

methods.name: xValueModifier
methods.description: Prepares or modifies the input value `x` (which can be a string or null) for persistence. The implementation is user-defined and may involve sanitization, formatting, or other transformations.
